method: Production property mapping and minification; 4/8/16 players, 32 scenery tracks, 30-second fixture, 60 Hz rendering, 30 Hz snapshots (10 Hz slow). Three process repetitions per variant with balanced rotating order. Each process primes all five scenarios with 10 replays each, then each case with 5 replays, then 5 CPU blocks of 10 replays. CPU is user+system time per replay; quality excludes first 5 seconds. 16 MiB semi-space. 15 CPU samples per variant/case. No browser rendering, real transport or decoding.
